title: Nourishing Uruguayan Wood Ear Mushrooms Skewers
description: Resinous, shaggy, adventurous wood ear mushrooms glazed with a sweet soy and lime blend, grilled on a robata for an anti-inflammatory-friendly bite.
instructions: Rinse wood ear mushrooms and soak in warm water for 20 minutes until softened.
Drain and pat dry, then slice into 2-inch pieces suitable for skewering.
Whisk soy sauce, mirin, sesame oil, minced garlic, grated ginger, lime juice, honey and chili flakes until honey dissolves.
Thread mushroom slices onto pre-soaked bamboo skewers, leaving a small gap between each piece.
Brush mushrooms with the prepared glaze, reserving some for later basting.
Preheat a robata grill or grill pan to medium-high and lightly oil the grates.
Grill skewers for 3-4 minutes per side, basting with glaze, until glossy and slightly charred.
Remove from grill, sprinkle with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
